content.value: A combination circuit is defined by the following three equations: $\mathrm { \bf { F } } _ { 1 } = \mathrm { \bf { x } } ^ { \prime } \mathrm { \bf { y } } ^ { \prime } + \mathrm { \bf { x } } \mathrm { \bf { y } } \mathrm { \bf { z } } ^ { \prime }$ (12) $\mathrm { F } _ { 2 } = \mathrm { x } ^ { \prime } + \mathrm { y } , \mathrm { F } _ { 3 } \stackrel { . } { = } \mathrm { x y } + \mathrm { x } ^ { \prime } \mathrm { y } ^ { \prime } .$ Design the circuit with a decoder and external gates.
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in Script B)
